verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's Workflows feature explicitly supports sending customized 'meeting lifecycle messages' with adjustable timing and content designed 'to minimize no-shows,' plus Zapier integration for further automation (e.g., SMS via third-party apps). However, native SMS reminders are not documented—only email-based workflow messages and templates are described, with SMS presumably requiring Zapier/CRM integration rather than being built-in. missing for 10: native SMS reminder capability, evidence of automatic sequencing/multi-touch cadence beyond single reminders, independent confirmation of no-show reduction impact.
